result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Customer-related data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, followed by deletion and written certification. The additions are limited to the required exit obligations and preserve the remaining termination mechanics. Drafting is professional overall, though “six (6) (or, if requested, any shorter) months” is unnecessarily awkward, and the sequencing of deletion could be stated more precisely.
